$comment: The authoritative environment binding of the F-5 runtime-dependency composition, as an example local environment. It realizes the sibling example_runtime_dependency_instance.json in this directory, which is assembled from the sibling example_runtime_dependency_manifest.json, composed by example_runtime_dependency_request.json. ADR-0021 §3 and owner decision P1 fix the dependency endpoint as STATICALLY AND EXPLICITLY DECLARED here: Deployment & Operations allocates no endpoint dynamically, discovers no service and substitutes no address. The provider declares the endpoint it serves ('published_endpoint'); the consumer declares the endpoint it reaches ('dependency_endpoints') and the version range that endpoint's component must satisfy. The two must correspond exactly or the environment is rejected before anything is provisioned. Secrets are deliberately absent from this document: the service credential Identity presents to Tenant Authority is injected at the process boundary, e.g. --secret TENANT_AUTHORITY_SERVICE_TOKEN=<ENVVAR> (ADR-0016 §12). The endpoints below are loopback values of an example local environment; an owner's own environment document declares its own addresses.
